name: Microsoft 365: management activity, Cloud App Security, message trace, service health
description: Six Microsoft 365 sourcetypes: Office 365 Management Activity API audit records (ms:o365:management), Defender for Cloud Apps alerts (o365:cas:api), Exchange Online message trace (o365:graph:messagetrace), Entra ID directory metadata (o365:metadata), and Microsoft 365 service health issues and message center posts (o365:service:healthIssue, o365:service:updateMessage). Extended with three more sourcetypes: the raw (all-workload) Management Activity API feed (o365:management:activity), Microsoft Entra sign-in plus Office 365 Groups usage-activity report rows sharing one sourcetype (o365:graph:api), and the legacy Get-MessageTrace shape of Exchange Online message trace (o365:reporting:messagetrace).
source: Office 365 Management Activity API schema; Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps Alerts API; Microsoft Graph exchangeMessageTrace, user, serviceHealthIssue and serviceUpdateMessage resources; splunk_ta_o365 and Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices field extraction read from this dev Splunk's own conf-props and conf-transforms. Microsoft Graph signIn resource; Microsoft Graph reportRoot getOffice365GroupsActivityDetail report; Exchange Online Get-MessageTrace cmdlet; observed columns read from this dev Splunk's own indexed data for all nine sourcetypes.

feed.label: Microsoft 365 activity and health
feed.description: Office 365 Management Activity API audit records, Defender for Cloud Apps alerts, Exchange Online message trace, Entra ID directory metadata, and Microsoft 365 service health and message center posts.

mgmt_event_id.label: Audit record id
mgmt_event_id.description: Unique identifier of this one audit record.

mgmt_creation_time.label: Creation time
mgmt_creation_time.description: When the audit log record was generated, in UTC.

mgmt_record_type.label: Audit record type
mgmt_record_type.description: Which AuditLogRecordType this record is; ms:o365:management carries only the AzureActiveDirectory workload's own two values (8, 9), o365:management:activity the full range across every workload.

mgmt_operation.label: Operation
mgmt_operation.description: The name of the user or admin activity that produced this record, for example PasswordLogonInitialAuthUsingPassword or Add User.

mgmt_org_id.label: Organization id
mgmt_org_id.description: The Microsoft 365 tenant this record belongs to.

mgmt_result_status.label: Result status
mgmt_result_status.description: Whether the Operation succeeded, straight from the vendor's ResultStatus (or, on the CIM result field, defaulted to success when ResultStatus is absent).

mgmt_status_norm.label: CIM status
mgmt_status_norm.description: ResultStatus normalised to Splunk CIM's success/failure vocabulary by this dev Splunk's own o365_status_lookup.

mgmt_user_key.label: User key
mgmt_user_key.description: An alternative id for UserId; populated with the passport unique id (PUID) for SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange events.

mgmt_user_type.label: User type
mgmt_user_type.description: What kind of user performed the operation: regular user, admin, system, and so on.

mgmt_workload.label: Workload
mgmt_workload.description: The Office 365 service the activity happened in, for example AzureActiveDirectory.

mgmt_client_ip.label: Client IP
mgmt_client_ip.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 address the activity was logged from. Null for Microsoft Entra ID events, which do not log an address here.

mgmt_object_id.label: Object id
mgmt_object_id.description: The object the operation acted on; meaning depends on workload (a SharePoint/OneDrive path, an Exchange cmdlet's target, and so on). For this pack's AzureActiveDirectory records it is the account UPN the Operation was performed on.

mgmt_user_id.label: User id (UPN)
mgmt_user_id.description: The UPN of the user who performed the Operation, for example my_name@my_domain_name. System accounts such as NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM also appear here.

mgmt_azuread_event_type.label: Microsoft Entra event type
mgmt_azuread_event_type.description: The type of Microsoft Entra event this AzureActiveDirectory-workload record is.

mgmt_actor_id.label: Actor id
mgmt_actor_id.description: The id half of one Actor {ID,Type} pair: the user or service principal that performed the action, in the form its Type says.

mgmt_actor_type.label: Actor id type
mgmt_actor_type.description: What kind of identity Actor{}.ID is (a claim, a display name, a PUID, a service principal name, a UPN, or an opaque other id).

mgmt_actor_context_id.label: Actor context id
mgmt_actor_context_id.description: The tenant Actor{}.ID should be read within.

mgmt_target_id.label: Target id
mgmt_target_id.description: The id half of one Target {ID,Type} pair: an entity the Operation was performed on, in the form its Type says.

mgmt_target_type.label: Target id type
mgmt_target_type.description: What kind of identity Target{}.ID is; same IdentityType vocabulary as Actor{}.Type.

mgmt_target_context_id.label: Target context id
mgmt_target_context_id.description: The tenant Target{}.ID should be read within.

mgmt_intersystems_id.label: Inter-systems id
mgmt_intersystems_id.description: A correlation id this pack's vendor pages do not define; present on change records in the sample (Actor/Target present) and absent from the two logon records.

mgmt_intrasystem_id.label: Intra-system id
mgmt_intrasystem_id.description: A second correlation id, alongside InterSystemsId, that this pack's vendor pages do not define.

mgmt_login_status.label: Logon status
mgmt_login_status.description: The OrgIdLogon.LoginStatus code for this logon; 0 is success, any other value a specific logon failure reason.

mgmt_user_domain.label: User domain
mgmt_user_domain.description: The tenant identity information (TII) domain for UserId.

mgmt_client.label: Client
mgmt_client.description: Details about the client device, OS and browser used for a logon event.

mgmt_extended_properties.label: Extended properties
mgmt_extended_properties.description: A name/value bag of extra properties the Microsoft Entra event carries; this pack's sample uses it for a failed logon's LoginError text.

mgmt_request_type.label: CIM request type
mgmt_request_type.description: A CIM-facing category calculated from source and Workload, not a vendor field.

mgmt_model_type.label: CIM data model type
mgmt_model_type.description: The Splunk CIM data model this operation maps to (auth, account, and so on), looked up by Operation and ResultStatus.

mgmt_action.label: CIM action
mgmt_action.description: The CIM action verb for this Operation (created, modified, success, failure, and so on), from the same model lookup.

mgmt_change_type.label: CIM change type
mgmt_change_type.description: A coarse change-category tag from the model lookup; observed values in this dev Splunk are AAA and user.

mgmt_object_category.label: CIM object category
mgmt_object_category.description: What kind of object the operation touched (user, group, and so on), from the model lookup.

mgmt_object.label: CIM object
mgmt_object.description: The CIM object field: SourceFileName when present, else ObjectId.

mgmt_object_path.label: CIM object path
mgmt_object_path.description: ObjectId again, kept only when it is not the literal Not Available.

mgmt_file_name.label: File name
mgmt_file_name.description: SourceFileName, aliased to the CIM file_name field; not present in this pack's own sample.

mgmt_file_path.label: File path
mgmt_file_path.description: SourceRelativeUrl, aliased to the CIM file_path field; not present in this pack's own sample.

mgmt_vendor_product.label: CIM vendor_product
mgmt_vendor_product.description: A constant, Microsoft Cloud Services: followed by Workload.

cas_alert_id.label: Alert id
cas_alert_id.description: The alert's own id, a 24-character hex string (a MongoDB-style ObjectId).

cas_alert_type_id.label: Alert type identifier
cas_alert_type_id.description: An integer alert-type id, distinct from the alert's own _id despite the vendor page's property table describing _id with this same phrase.

cas_alert_timestamp.label: Alert timestamp
cas_alert_timestamp.description: When the alert was raised, epoch milliseconds.

cas_alert_read_status.label: Read status
cas_alert_read_status.description: Whether the alert is unread, read or archived.

cas_alert_resolution_status.label: Resolution status
cas_alert_resolution_status.description: The analyst's disposition of the alert: open, dismissed, resolved, or closed as false positive, benign or true positive.

cas_alert_is_system.label: System alert flag
cas_alert_is_system.description: Whether this is a built-in system alert (as opposed to a policy-rule alert).

cas_alert_stories.label: Risk category
cas_alert_stories.description: The risk category (story) this alert belongs to, for example threat detection or DLP.

cas_alert_threat_score.label: Threat score
cas_alert_threat_score.description: A numeric threat score Defender for Cloud Apps assigned the alert.

cas_alert_comment.label: Analyst comment
cas_alert_comment.description: A free-text comment an analyst left on the alert.

cas_alert_handled_by.label: Handled by
cas_alert_handled_by.description: The analyst who closed or is handling the alert; not the alert's subject.

cas_alert_resolve_time.label: Resolve time
cas_alert_resolve_time.description: When the alert was resolved, an ISO 8601 timestamp.

cas_alert_portal_url.label: Alert portal URL
cas_alert_portal_url.description: The Defender for Cloud Apps portal link for this alert; also copied onto the CIM src and dest fields, which are not network endpoints here.

cas_alert_context_id.label: Context id
cas_alert_context_id.description: An id this pack's vendor pages do not define; in the sample it matches the related device entity's id.

cas_alert_app.label: CIM app
cas_alert_app.description: A constant, Microsoft Cloud App Security.

cas_alert_signature.label: CIM signature
cas_alert_signature.description: The alert title again, on the CIM signature field.

cas_entity.label: Related entity
cas_entity.description: One entity (a user, device, service, policy or tag) named by the alert; id and label identify it, type says which of the five.

cas_entity_role.label: Entity role
cas_entity_role.description: Whether this entity is the alert's Source or only Related.

cas_entity_type_int.label: Entity type (integer)
cas_entity_type_int.description: An undocumented integer form of entities[].type; use the string type field instead.

cas_entity_principal.label: Entity principal address
cas_entity_principal.description: The email address of an account entity.

cas_entity_policy_type.label: Entity policy type
cas_entity_policy_type.description: For a policyRule entity, which kind of policy triggered it, for example ANOMALY_DETECTION.

cas_entity_instance.label: Entity instance
cas_entity_instance.description: An instance number on the source entity; 0 in this pack's sample.

trace_id.label: Message trace id
trace_id.description: The unique identifier for this message trace record.

trace_message_id.label: Message-ID header
trace_message_id.description: The message's own Message-ID header value; its format depends on the sending server.

trace_received_time.label: Received time
trace_received_time.description: When Exchange Online received the message, UTC.

trace_sender.label: Sender address
trace_sender.description: The SMTP address the message was purportedly from.

trace_recipient.label: Recipient address
trace_recipient.description: The SMTP address the message was addressed to.

trace_size.label: Message size
trace_size.description: The size of the message in bytes.

trace_from_ip.label: Source IP
trace_from_ip.description: For an incoming message, the public IP address of the SMTP server that sent it.

trace_to_ip.label: Destination IP
trace_to_ip.description: For an outgoing message, the resolved MX IP of the destination domain; blank for incoming mail.

trace_status.label: Delivery status
trace_status.description: The message's delivery status, for example delivered, pending or quarantined.

trace_cim_action.label: CIM action
trace_cim_action.description: status normalised to a delivered/blocked/quarantined verb by this dev Splunk's own lookup.

trace_recipient_count.label: Recipient count
trace_recipient_count.description: Calculated as the literal 1 on every record.

trace_recipient_domain.label: Recipient domain
trace_recipient_domain.description: The domain half of recipientAddress, regex-extracted.

trace_src_user_domain.label: Sender domain
trace_src_user_domain.description: The domain half of senderAddress, regex-extracted.

meta_object_id.label: Directory object id
meta_object_id.description: The user's Microsoft Entra ID directory object id: stable, opaque, and not aliased onto any CIM field here.

meta_display_name.label: Display name
meta_display_name.description: The name shown in the address book, usually first name plus family name.

meta_upn.label: User principal name
meta_upn.description: The user's sign-in name; also aliased onto the CIM user_id field here, so that CIM field is a readable UPN, not a stable id.

meta_business_phones.label: Business phones
meta_business_phones.description: The user's telephone numbers; documented as a collection but only one number can actually be set.

meta_preferred_language.label: Preferred language
meta_preferred_language.description: An RFC 4646 language tag, for example en-US.

svc_id.label: Issue or message id
svc_id.description: The id of the service issue or service message, for example EX226792 or MC172851.

svc_title.label: Title
svc_title.description: The title of the issue or message.

svc_start_time.label: Start time
svc_start_time.description: The start time of the issue or message.

svc_end_time.label: End time
svc_end_time.description: The end time of the issue or message.

svc_last_modified_time.label: Last modified time
svc_last_modified_time.description: The last time this post was edited; the field this dev Splunk's TIME_PREFIX indexes as _time.

svc_details.label: Additional details
svc_details.description: A name/value bag of extra details; observed keys are NotifyInApp (healthIssue) and ExternalLink (updateMessage).

health_classification.label: Classification
health_classification.description: Whether this is a service incident or a service advisory.

health_origin.label: Origin
health_origin.description: Who reported the issue: Microsoft, a third party or the customer.

health_status.label: Status
health_status.description: The issue's current status in Microsoft's incident lifecycle, for example investigating or serviceRestored.

health_service.label: Affected service
health_service.description: The Microsoft 365 service the issue affects, for example Exchange Online.

health_feature.label: Affected feature
health_feature.description: The specific feature of the service the issue affects.

health_feature_group.label: Feature group
health_feature_group.description: The feature group the affected feature belongs to.

health_impact_description.label: Impact description
health_impact_description.description: A description of how the issue affects users.

health_posts.label: Status posts
health_posts.description: The issue's collection of historical status posts: when each was created, its type, and its HTML content.

msg_category.label: Message category
msg_category.description: The service message's category: fix an issue, plan for a change, or stay informed.

msg_severity.label: Message severity
msg_severity.description: The severity of the service message.

msg_is_major_change.label: Major change flag
msg_is_major_change.description: Whether the message describes a major update to the service.

msg_tags.label: Tags
msg_tags.description: Free-text tags the posting team attached, for example whether the message covers a new feature.

msg_action_required_by.label: Action required by
msg_action_required_by.description: The deadline for any required action; null when there is none.

msg_expiry_time.label: Expiry time
msg_expiry_time.description: When the message expires from the message center; null when it does not.

msg_body.label: Message body
msg_body.description: The message's HTML body and its content type.

msg_view_point.label: Viewpoint
msg_view_point.description: Per-user read, archived and favorite state for the message; null when read with application permissions, as this pack's sample is.

mgmt_alert_id.label: Alert id
mgmt_alert_id.description: The id of the security or compliance alert this record reports on.

mgmt_alert_type.label: Alert type
mgmt_alert_type.description: Whether the alert was raised by a system detection or a custom alert policy, for example System.

mgmt_severity.label: Alert severity
mgmt_severity.description: The severity Microsoft assigned the alert, for example Informational, Low, Medium or High.

mgmt_policy_id.label: Policy id
mgmt_policy_id.description: The id of the alert or DLP policy that triggered this record.

mgmt_subject.label: Subject
mgmt_subject.description: The subject line of the mail item the operation acted on.

mgmt_device_id.label: Device id
mgmt_device_id.description: The Microsoft Entra device id of the client, present only for a registered or domain-joined device.

mgmt_client_app_id.label: Client app id
mgmt_client_app_id.description: The original caller's service or protocol identifier for the request.

mgmt_user_agent.label: User agent
mgmt_user_agent.description: The SharePoint client or browser string the operation was performed with.

mgmt_site_url.label: Site URL
mgmt_site_url.description: The URL of the SharePoint site the accessed file or folder is in.

signin_id.label: Sign-in id
signin_id.description: Unique id representing this sign-in activity.

signin_time.label: Sign-in time
signin_time.description: Date and time (UTC) the sign-in was initiated.

signin_app_id.label: Application id
signin_app_id.description: GUID of the application the user signed in to.

signin_app_name.label: Application name
signin_app_name.description: The app's display name in the Microsoft Entra admin center.

signin_client_app.label: Client app used
signin_client_app.description: The client used for the sign-in: modern clients report Browser or modern clients; legacy protocols report Exchange ActiveSync, IMAP, MAPI, SMTP, POP or other clients.

signin_conditional_access_status.label: Conditional access status
signin_conditional_access_status.description: Status of an activated Conditional Access policy for this sign-in: success, failure or notApplied.

signin_correlation_id.label: Correlation id
signin_correlation_id.description: The request id the client sent when the sign-in was initiated.

signin_ip.label: Sign-in IP
signin_ip.description: IP address of the client used to sign in.

signin_interactive.label: Interactive flag
signin_interactive.description: Whether the sign-in was interactive (a user present at a prompt).

signin_user_id.label: User id
signin_user_id.description: Microsoft Entra object id of the user who signed in.

signin_user_name.label: User display name
signin_user_name.description: Display name of the user who signed in.

signin_user_upn.label: User principal name
signin_user_upn.description: UPN of the user who signed in; for guest users this is stored in the resolved, lower-case form rather than the #EXT# form the user object carries.

signin_risk_level.label: Risk level
signin_risk_level.description: Aggregated or per-sign-in Entra ID Protection risk level: none, low, medium, high or hidden (hidden means the tenant or user is not enrolled in ID Protection P2).

signin_risk_state.label: Risk state
signin_risk_state.description: Status of the risky sign-in or the reason it was flagged, for example none, atRisk, confirmedCompromised or dismissed.

signin_resource_id.label: Resource id
signin_resource_id.description: Id of the resource the user signed in to.

signin_resource_name.label: Resource name
signin_resource_name.description: Display name of the resource the user signed in to.

signin_status.label: Sign-in status
signin_status.description: The nested signInStatus object: errorCode, failureReason and additionalDetails for a failed sign-in.

signin_device.label: Device detail
signin_device.description: The nested deviceDetail object: device id, display name, operating system, browser and compliance/management flags.

signin_location.label: Sign-in location
signin_location.description: The nested signInLocation object: city, state, country/region and geographic coordinates the sign-in was attributed to.

usage_group_activity.label: Groups activity detail
usage_group_activity.description: One row of the Office 365 Groups activity detail usage report: group identity, membership and per-workload (Exchange, SharePoint, Yammer) activity counters for the report period.

trace_organization.label: Organization
trace_organization.description: The tenant's default domain the message trace was run against.

ms:o365:management.description: Office 365 Management Activity API audit records, AzureActiveDirectory workload, as Splunk_TA_microsoft-cloudservices indexes them (kept for backward compatibility; the same sourcetype's Office 365 Management Activity API input on the newer Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Office 365 is o365:management:activity).
ms:o365:management.note: Actor and Target are JSON arrays of {ID,Type} pairs; KV_MODE=json flattens each to a multivalued Actor{}.ID / Actor{}.Type pair of fields.

o365:cas:api.description: Alerts visible through the Microsoft Cloud App Security / Defender for Cloud Apps portal API, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes the /api/v1/alerts/ response: one alert object per line, unwrapped.

o365:graph:messagetrace.description: Exchange Online message trace records from the Microsoft Graph messageTraces endpoint, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes them: one exchangeMessageTrace object per line.

o365:metadata.description: Microsoft Entra ID directory user objects from the Graph /users endpoint, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes them for lookup enrichment: one user object per line.
o365:metadata.note: No time_field: this sourcetype carries no event time, only Splunk's own index time.

o365:service:healthIssue.description: Service health issues (incidents and advisories) from the Microsoft Graph serviceAnnouncement/issues endpoint, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes them.

o365:service:updateMessage.description: Service message center posts from the Microsoft Graph serviceAnnouncement/messages endpoint, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes them.

o365:management:activity.description: Office 365 Management Activity API audit records, all workloads, as the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Office 365 indexes the raw JSON (no CIM field mapping): the same feed ms:o365:management carries for the AzureActiveDirectory workload only, here across every RecordType (Exchange, SharePoint, Yammer, Teams, SecurityComplianceCenter, Power Platform and more).
o365:management:activity.note: 534 distinct keys observed in this dev Splunk across the sampled RecordType values; most are workload- or operation-specific parameters (mail rule conditions, DLP policy rule detail, admin cmdlet parameters) and are not bound here.

o365:graph:api.description: Microsoft Graph API pulls landed on one generic sourcetype by the Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Office 365: Microsoft Entra sign-in activity (the signIn resource) and, in this dev Splunk's seed, Office 365 Groups usage-activity report rows (reportRoot: getOffice365GroupsActivityDetail). The two record shapes share no fields; which one a record is shows in whether id/createdDateTime/userId or Group Id/Report Period is present.

o365:reporting:messagetrace.description: Exchange Online message trace records from the Get-MessageTrace cmdlet / reporting web service, as splunk_ta_o365 indexes them under the PascalCase column names the older reporting API used; the same data o365:graph:messagetrace carries from the newer Graph messageTraces endpoint.

time_no_zone.text: CreationTime has no UTC offset though the schema says every timestamp is UTC; a bare string compare against a local time silently shifts the window.

time_epoch_vs_iso.text: timestamp is epoch milliseconds (this dev Splunk's TIME_FORMAT is %s%3N) while resolveTime on the same record is an ISO 8601 string; the two are not interchangeable.

time_frac_seconds_missing.text: props.conf expects receivedDateTime with seven fractional digits (TIME_FORMAT %7N) but every vendor example and this pack's samples have none; the second still parses, a stricter downstream format check would not.

time_edit_not_incident.text: lastModifiedDateTime, not startDateTime, is the field this dev Splunk's TIME_PREFIX indexes as _time; a time-range search finds when the post was last edited, not when the issue or message actually started.

no_time_field.text: o365:metadata carries no event time field at all (entry.json marks it index_time_ok); only Splunk's own index time is available.

ids_look_alike_mgmt.text: Id, InterSystemsId, IntraSystemId, ActorContextId and TargetContextId are all GUID-shaped. Only Id identifies this audit record; the others identify a cross-system correlation, a session and a tenant. Do not join on shape alone.

ids_look_alike_cas.text: the Alerts API's own property table labels _id as an 'Alert type identifier', but in the List response's example _id is the alert's own 24-character id and idValue (a separate integer field) is the type identifier. Trust the example, not that row of the table.

underscore_stripped.text: the vendor's field is _id; this dev Splunk's JSON key-value extraction strips the leading underscore (reserved for Splunk's own internal fields), so the identical value also appears as id.

identitytype_int_undocumented.text: the IdentityType enum table names its members (Claim, Name, Other, PUID, SPN, UPN) but the schema page never publishes which integer is which; treat an observed Actor.Type or Target.Type value as an opaque code, not a name.

aadeventtype_int_undocumented.text: the AzureActiveDirectoryEventType table publishes only two member names with no integers; every record in this pack's sample carries 0, and which name that is stays undocumented.

entitytype_int_undocumented.text: entities[].entityType is an integer the Alerts API pages never define; entities[].type, a separate string field, is the one the docs and the samples actually use to tell entity kinds apart.

request_type_constructed.text: request_type is not a vendor field; EVAL-request_type calculates it from a case-sensitive match on source and Workload. This pack's own sample notes the exact source string was constructed, not read from a running poller, since no o365-polling TA is installed next to the CIM add-on here.

toip_blank_incoming.text: toIP is documented blank for incoming mail; every sample record in this pack is incoming, so an empty toIP is expected, not missing data.

recipient_count_constant.text: recipient_count is calculated to the literal 1 on every record; it does not count the message's actual recipients.

resultstatus_vocabulary_varies.text: ResultStatus's vocabulary depends on the workload: Succeeded, PartiallySucceeded or Failed for most audit activity, True or False for Exchange admin activity, and lowercase success or failed for the Azure AD logon events in this pack's own sample. o365_status_lookup normalises five such literals to success or failure and leaves anything else unset.

resultstatus_sts_caveat.text: for Microsoft Entra ID STS logon events the vendor doc warns ResultStatus=Succeeded means only that the HTTP call succeeded, not that the sign-in did; LoginStatus (0 for success, any other value a logon error code) carries the real outcome.

severity_id_duplicate.text: severity_id repeats severityValue for a system alert and has no value at all for a policy-based alert; it is not a second, independent severity.

signin_time_vs_timestamp.text: createdDateTime (signin_time) is the Graph API's own UTC sign-in clock. This dev Splunk also lands a bare 'timestamp' field on the same event (Splunk's own extraction, not a Graph property, and left unbound here); the two are not always the same instant. Sort and window on createdDateTime.

signin_ids_look_alike.text: id (signin_id), correlationId (signin_correlation_id) and resourceId (signin_resource_id) are all GUID-shaped. id identifies this sign-in event; correlationId is client-supplied and only useful to line up client and server logs of the same attempt; resourceId names the application signed into, not the user or the sign-in.
